sources.name: Trinidad Guardian — Chaguanas maxi protest
sources.claim: Green-band maxi riders normally drop out in communities along the Southern Main Road between Chaguanas and San Fernando; Claxton Bay commuters affected.

sources.name: Trinidad and Tobago Newsday — Claxton Bay residents, maxi taxi drivers hold fiery protest
sources.claim: Identifies a Chaguanas-to-San Fernando maxi driver operating along the Claxton Bay Southern Main Road corridor.

sources.name: Trinidad and Tobago Newsday — Claxton Bay drivers, residents welcome news of planned roadworks
sources.claim: Reports from the San Fernando-to-Chaguanas maxi stand; driver describes Southern Main Road conditions from California toward St Margaret's.

sources.name: Southern Main Road route description
sources.claim: Road corridor passes through Chaguanas, Chase Village area, Couva, California, Claxton Bay, Marabella and San Fernando. Used as geography support only, not boarding proof.

localReview.claim: Some Chaguanas-San Fernando maxis run through the main-road communities and riders can hail/get off along the route; California to Claxton Bay is a representative use case.

sources.name: Sir Solomon Hochoy Highway route description
sources.claim: Highway provides a distinct Chaguanas-San Fernando road path with interchanges serving central communities. Interchange proximity is not stop evidence.
